race.description: Vale Lvtc Life Member Tony Prentice Hcp (55)
race.comment: OCEAN JOY (8) is the one to beat with the drop out of a CL2 at Toowoomba a strong pointer. She began slowly there, was still well back turning and picked up nicely to finish fifth. If she can settle a pair or two closer this time she will prove hard to stop. MAJESTIC LOUVRE (1) brings the steadier recent profile, having placed at Dalby before a fourth at Ipswich. Gets help at the weights with the 3kg claimer going on and looms a genuine threat. ROCKY BLONDE (10) is racing consistently and her latest Dalby third reads well for this, though MAJESTIC LOUVRE did have her measure the start prior. STARWARD (5) had genuine excuses when wide and bumped at Sunshine Coast after a narrow Kilcoy second. In the mix.
